name: Kids Chaos VR
summary:
Kids Chaos VR is a funny VR daycare chaos game where a normal playroom turns into total mayhem.

Step into a colorful daycare full of toys, kids, silly pranks, funny hats, food reactions, and one very dramatic grandma trying to keep everything under control.

Play tag with the kids, run through the daycare, use toys, unlock hats, collect coins, and create chaotic moments around the room. Throw a banana peel, spray a water gun, play with a ball, try different foods, and watch the characters react in funny wa
